full_details: The oak was green and almost yellow, four bays, twelve men, poles and two ropes. The first cross-frame went up sweetly. On the second you had the foot of a post with Richard. Something in the small of the back let go like a snapped lute-string. You did not fall. Your father, from a ladder, asked whether you were praying or lifting, and then he saw your face. Anne had been at the edge with a jug since eight. She said nothing kind. At home, on the bed over the hall, she shut the shutter and said she had you. You did not go back for the ale.
one_sentence: You raised the first of the frame cleanly, lifted the second from the back, and went home bent between Richard and Sadler.
title: The first bay sweet, the second a lute-string
